about.title: About Me
about.content: I'm a creative developer passionate about building products that are both visually compelling and technically refined. My background in motion design and video editing allows me to approach digital experiences with a strong sense of storytelling, while my front-end development skills help transform ideas into fast, responsive, and intuitive interfaces. I believe great design isn't just about appearance—it's about creating experiences people remember.

what_i_do.title: What I Do
what_i_do.dev_desc: Building modern, responsive, and fast websites with React & Tailwind. Turning ideas into clean code.
what_i_do.video_desc: Telling visual stories with After Effects & Premiere. Professional editing, color grading, and motion graphics.

videoPage.subtitle: A selection of motion graphics and video editing projects crafted with attention to detail, cinematic pacing, and purposeful storytelling.
